_note: Flight-duration achievements (src/constants.js FLIGHT_ACHIEVEMENTS). Same array shape as ach_translations_dist.json: [title, post-earned description, pre-earned description]. Play Console has ONE description field - use the pre-earned string there. Icons: achievement-icons/flight_1min.png, flight_2min.png (512x512 RGB, no alpha). Points: 1min 15, 2min 30 - escalation mirrors score_1000/score_10000 (10/25) and streak_7/streak_30 (10/30), since a 'good' run is only ~20-36s and a 'great' run ~54-97s (see CLAUDE.md POISON_INTERVAL_SEC doc), so even 1 minute is a solidly above-average run and 2 minutes is deep-run territory. Hidden: No. Incremental: No. Title style follows the existing 'Four Digits'/'Five Digits'/'Six Digits' numeric-tier convention rather than an evocative name.
